column3: Handy early - scrappy at the 6th - pushed into the front 3 out - stayed on well 2 out - clean leap at the last then edged clear margin narrowed close home but held on
Settled towards back early - still handy 4 out - pressed for effort before 2 out - moved into third near the last - stayed on to close but denied by three quarters of a length

Settled in mid-pack early - handy with the front group 4 out - pushed along soon after - closed on the front-runner 2 out - hit last and dropped back to third - stayed on at an even effort to finish third
Settled at the back - gradual progress to join the front group 4 out - nudged along and third 2 out - plugged on at one speed on the run-in to finish fourth
Close to the pace early - hit front before 2nd but jumped awkwardly - pressed for effort before 4 out - lost advantage 3 out - unable to threaten again before fading out of contention
Handy early - dropped away before the 14th and faded under pressure before 4 out - well beaten by 2 out
Settled in the pack early - pushed along near the back approaching the 15th - eased out of contention before 4 out
Held a midpack spot early - urged along and dropped towards the back before the 11th - pulled up after the 14th
Went forward eagerly early - hit the front for a spell after the start - sat close up - still in the mix with the pace 4 out - pushed along - dropped away 3 out before being pulled up
Front throughout - pressed into a gallop 2f out - pulled further ahead inside the final furlong - won going easily
Slow to begin - settled in the pack - niggled into contention from 3f out and moved to 4th 2f out - stayed on over final furlong - well held in 2nd
Sat behind the pace - driven on 3f out and kept on without threatening the winner - edged out for second late
Settled around midfield - asked for effort 3f out but boxed in - driven with 2f to run - found some late finishing energy - not really a threat to the principals
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along with over 2f left - kept going without threatening finishing 5th
Slow to begin - held up at back - urged into effort 3f out - kept on veering left but held finishing position
Slow to break - settled midpack early - moved into third with 4f left - driven approaching the final 3f - lost ground steadily inside the last furlong to finish seventh
Sat close behind the front group early - urged forward before losing touch approaching 3f out - well held at the finish
Sat close to the front group early - driven to keep tempo but faded 4f out - dropped well back thereafter - well held at the finish

Settled in the pack early - improved to sit behind the front group by the 9th - pushed along and moved through to hit the front before 2 out - opened a three-length gap approaching the last but hit it awkwardly - margin narrowed near the line to scrape home
Pulling hard early - settled towards back of field - pressed on and staying involved 2 out - made ground approaching final flight - finished strongly to go down by a whisker

Settled towards the back early - still within range of the front group 3 out but scrambled the fence - pushed along and shared second spot 2 out - stayed on at one gear approaching the last - handed back second before the finish to end third
Settled towards the back early - closed onto the front group by 3 out and pushed into contention for second 2 out - hit the last and slipped to fourth at the finish
Settled close to pace early - shared front spot before 9th - went clear 3 out - pushed along and overtaken before 2 out then dropped away quickly
Handy early - lost touch before 9th and pushed along in vain - well beaten before 2 out

Sent to front early - held narrow advantage until challenged before the 9th - lost position 3 out after an untidy jump then quickly came under pressure and dropped away - eased out of contention before the second last
Jumped a bit ragged early - settled in mid-division - dropped away suddenly and was eased out of contention before 3 out
Settled off the leading duo - moved into second with 3f left before taking command approaching the final two furlongs - kept finding more to pull clear near the finish
Set the pace and challenged intermittently - driven forward with three furlongs left before losing top spot inside the last two - stayed on without finding more late to finish second
Settled just behind the front-runner - asked for effort before 3f out - dropped back soon after - kept going to finish third

Handy early with front group - clean leap to close in 4th out - upped tempo on the pace 3 out - moved through to front before 2 out though slightly awkward there - asked for effort and edged away then kept on strongly to the line
Settled off the pace early - improved into contention 3 out and pressed for the lead approaching the last - stayed on to finish second - unable to reel in the winner
Handy early - hit front before 3rd - shared advantage 3 out then driven and put in front before 2 out where slightly awkward - couldn't quicken and gave up second spot before last

Went straight to front but scratchy over 1st - overtaken before 3rd - awkward again 7th - dropped from second spot 4 out then slipped further back 3 out - pushed along but unable to close before 2 out - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back - slipped to the tail of the field before 4 out - pressed for effort and faded before 2 out - eventually finished 5th
Slow to break - held up early - moved left and made progress over 2f out - shifted right and stayed on inside final furlong - driven to the front close home and prevailed comfortably
Held up towards back of pack - made progress from 2f out and moved right approaching final furlong - driven along to hit front inside final 110yds - caught close home

Sat close to the front pack - pushed along to edge ahead just over a furlong out - overtaken and dropped to third inside the final 110 yards - unable to find more late and held for third beaten 3 lengths
drifted left at the break - settled just off the pace - went to the front at halfway - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken inside the final furlong and dropped away to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with two furlongs left then found some response inside the final furlong - unable to reach the front rank finishing fifth
Held up behind the front group - driven approaching final furlong - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 6th
Settled in the pack early - improved into contention 2f out - driven approaching final furlong then lost ground steadily to finish 7th
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - failed to threaten the front end - finished eighth beaten 7¼ lengths
Drifted right early - held handy midfield position - asked for effort with 2f left then dropped away - finished ninth
Set the pace early - lost the front spot at halfway but stayed in touch - urged for effort 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish tenth
Bumped for room at the off - dropped to the back of the field - nudged forward before halfway without landing a blow - well held in 11th
Hampered start settling towards the back - urged into effort by halfway - dropped away 2f out to finish well held
Settled midway - hit trouble at the first and slipped to the back - urged along approaching three out - made progress into second before the last - stayed on strongly to score right on the line
Settled midpack early - closed on front group 3 out - shaken up to hit front before 2 out and opened a two-length advantage approaching the last - held effort but caught right at the line
Settled towards back early - improved into contention 3 out and pushed after the front-runner before 2 out - maintained effort but slipped to third close to the last
Settled mid-pack - close to the pace 3 out - pressed for effort and slipped back before 2 out - nudged into fourth approaching the last
Set the pace early - lost front spot at the 5th before edging back in front after 3 out under pressure - faded before 2 out to finish 5th
Settled in the pack early - jumped poorly 6th and pushed along after the third-last - dropped away approaching two out to finish sixth
Fought for control early - up with the pace and into the advantage at the 5th - lost the front and pushed along after 3 out - dropped away before 2 out to finish well beaten
Held up early - jumped awkwardly in 4th - pulled up before two out
Prominent early - error 6th brought on pressure and dropped away - stopped before 2 out
Fought for control early - tracking front group - pressed for effort before 3 out - lost ground quickly and eased out of contention before 2 out
Settled just behind the front group - driven into a slender advantage inside the final two furlongs - battled on gamely under pressure - stayed strongest to score

Held up towards the back - made steady progress into contention over 2f out - shaken up to challenge before the final furlong and locked in a battle for the lead - held on gamely without finding more close home
Settled in the pack early - asked for effort over 2f out and made ground - moved into third approaching the final furlong - then flattened out under pressure to finish third
Held up at the back - asked for effort 2f out but boxed in - shifted left then right to find room - kept on under pressure to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - made ground into contention over 2f out - driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish fifth
Held up in midfield - pushed along inside final furlong and responded briefly - weakened close home to finish sixth
drifted left from the break - settled in the pack - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to find any headway thereafter and finished seventh
Sent to front early - pressed for effort with 2f left - quickly overtaken and dropped away - finished 8th
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away soon after - finished ninth
Held up towards the back - urged to improve with 2f left - found nothing - eventually finished 10th
Held up in touch early - urged for effort with 2f left - dropped away quietly inside final furlong - finished well held
Held a midfield position early - urged forward approaching 3f out - lost touch with the pack 2f out and beaten well home

Settled in the pack early - moved up behind the front-runner before the 7th and driven along a length back when suddenly hit the front 2 out where bumped and nearly came unshipped - kept driving to the line and asserted approaching the final fence to score
Settled close up early - lost touch and dropped well back before three out - promoted to second when others faded two out - stayed there to the line albeit well beaten
Never featured with the pace - settled towards the rear throughout - stayed on for third but well beaten
Fought for control early - settled towards rear of field - scrappy over 2nd - never landed a blow and well held into the finish
Front early - clear under pressure before coming down at the second last
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort after the 4th - struggling towards the back and mistimed a jump at the 5th - pulled up after the 6th
Set off in front and soon opened a big advantage - pushed along inside the final furlong and drifted left - stayed on unopposed to the line
Settled behind the front-runner - drifted left-to-right the whole way - urged forward from 2f out and kept responding - unable to challenge the winner but held on for second beaten 5 lengths
Sat behind the front-running rival - urged forward with over 2f left - stayed on at one gear to finish third
Sat handy in fourth early - pushed along over 2f out - found nothing under pressure to finish fourth
Sluggish start - stayed at the back for the remainder - well held in 5th

Settled just behind the pace under strong restraint - hit the front briefly hampered in stride 3 out - moved into command alone approaching 2 out - asked for effort and stretched advantage - maintained the gap to the line unchallenged
Slow to go forward early - hit front soon after - error 5th - pushed along and lost advantage before 2 out where remained in second - eased away from finishing 2nd
Settled at back early - stayed within range of front group by 5th - pushed along and edged ahead just before 2 out but drifted right and exited the course
Set the pace from the off - drifted right when asked for effort inside final furlong - kept finding more under pressure from either flank to prevail narrowly

Tracked the pace up with the front group - pressed the winner from inside the final furlong and closed strongly with a shout of victory approaching the final 110yds - couldn't find more in the last strides
Settled in the pack early - moved through from two out and closed on the leader inside the last furlong - held for third late
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - made smooth progress from a furlong out - closed on the front three inside the final 110yds and stayed on to finish fourth
Held a forward position early - lost momentum inside final furlong - dropped away close home to finish fifth
Held a central position early - lost touch with leaders two out - driven approaching final furlong and stayed on without gaining more ground
Held up towards the back - lost touch approaching the final furlong - found a bit late close home to finish 7th
Held up in the pack - lost touch two out and pressed for effort - gave way close home finishing eighth
Handy in the pack early - driven with two furlongs left then lost ground a furlong out - dropped away quickly finishing ninth
Held up in the pack early - slipped to the back with 2f left - beaten well before the line
Pulling hard early - hit the front - lost lead 3rd - pressed for advantage 2 out and back in command before last - stayed on to win
Jumping errors early - held up handy - drifted right at 2nd - improved into contention before 2 out - overtaken approaching last but stayed on to finish 2nd

Pulled hard early - settled at the back - cleared the first fence well and moved up to dispute second before a collision - front by the third - pressure applied and fell back to third 2 out - stayed on at one tempo into the last to finish third 3.5 lengths adrift
Settled in the pack early - pushed along at the back after 3 out - moved up to fourth near the front pair by 2 out and stayed on at one gait to finish 4th
Pulled hard early - settled at back before pushed along and untidy two out - made no headway and clipped last

Settled in the pack early - jumped awkwardly at the fifth - error three out saw the jockey push along at the back - flickered into contention before the second-last then lost momentum nearing the final fence to finish sixth
Held up rear of field - eased off the pace and pulled up before the last
Settled close to pace early - pushed to challenge with a furlong left - edged in front inside final 110yds - had to fend off a rival close home - got up right at the line
Set the pace from the off - pushed along and challenged inside final furlong - overtaken close home - battled to the line - just denied in a photo finish
Settled just off the pace - asked for effort with 2f left and found extra late - nabbed third close home
Held up close to pace early - pushed into contention to challenge up front inside final furlong - weakened close home to finish fourth
Held up in the pack - pushed along inside final furlong - kept going but never got competitive - finished 5th beaten under three lengths
Sprang alertly at the break - settled just behind the pace - pushed along inside the final furlong but unable to make ground - finished sixth
Up with the pace - challenged for the front 2f out and edged left in the battle inside the final furlong - asserted in the dying strides to win
Settled close to the pace - closing on the front two with a furlong left - drifted left inside the final furlong and finished strongly - snatched second on the line
Set the pace early - drifted markedly left showing inexperience and was driven on approaching the final furlong - lost the advantage inside the last 110yds and edged back to third close home

Sluggish getaway - settled towards the back - shifted into the tail of the pack - urged forward with 2f left - closed on the front three inside final 110yds - stayed on well to finish fourth by half a length
Settled in the pack - driven into contention inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish fifth
Settled in the pack pulling hard early - made ground on the front group after 2f - lost touch with over 2f left - dropped away close home
Held up towards the back - lost touch two out then edged left and found a bit of late progress inside the final furlong - lost momentum again close home to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - lost touch after halfway - drifted left inside final furlong and faded to finish 8th
Handy early with front group - lost pace after halfway and slid backwards passing the furlong marker - trailed well beaten at the finish
Poor start - settled at back of field - dropped right out in final furlong - well held in 10th
Sat behind front group early - asked for effort 2f out to move into second - driven approaching final furlong to close in on pace-setter - got up in the final strides to score

Handy in the pack early - hit the front past 2f out and drove clear - driven out with 2f remaining and again inside final furlong - rival came back at closer quarters entering final 110yds - caught in the dying strides for second
Settled in the pack early - urged into fourth around 2f out - driven on approaching the final furlong but couldn't close on the leading two - held for third
Held a midfield spot - asked for effort with 2f left - kept trying without getting near the front runners
Settled towards the back - urged forward with 2f remaining - stayed on late but not achieving contention - finished fifth
Dropped in at the back early - drifted left approaching 3f out - stayed on late but far from a factor - finished sixth beaten 7 lengths
Sent clear early - driven approaching final 3f then lost command - dropped away 2f out to finish seventh
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward and lost ground with 2f left - well held at the finish
Handy in the early running - hit front three out - driven approaching two out - challenged inside final furlong - lost advantage briefly - fought back close home to prevail narrowly
Tracked in third - driven up 2f out to move into second - drifted right approaching final furlong - hit the front inside the last - overhauled close home - beaten a nose
Settled off the pace early - urged into fourth spot with two furlongs left - closed into third in the final 110 yards
Fought for control early and went straight to the front - shaken up and lost command over 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish fourth
Settled just off the pace - pushed along with 3f left - unable to close - finished fifth beaten around 8 lengths
Settled in the pack - urged forward but faded two out - well held from there

Held up towards the back early - began to make progress from over 3f out - pushed along approaching 2f out - drifted left to hit the front inside the final furlong - kept finding more to score comfortably - allowed to coast home clear
Set the pace early - under pressure with 2f left - overtaken inside the final furlong - stayed on but never troubling the winner
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward nearing 2f out - driven and unable to quicken final furlong - held on for third
Settled in the pack early - urged forward over 3f out into third - kept on at an unchanged effort to finish fourth
Sat close to pace early - urged forward with 3f left - driven but weakened inside final furlong - finished fifth
Slow start - held a midfield position - urged forward with two furlongs left but couldn't find any headway - well held in 6th
Close up on the rail - driven over 2f out - dropped away from that point to finish seventh
Tardy start - settled towards the back - under pressure 3f out and dropped out of contention
Driven to keep tabs at the back - lost touch and dropped away 3f out - well held at the finish
Settled midpack early - urged into effort by halfway but dropped away - well beaten by the finish
Set the pace from the off - pushed along inside final furlong - held on strongly to the line
Settled toward the rear early - driven along with two furlongs left and moved into second inside the final furlong - closed on the leader but unable to get on terms and finished second
Sat close to front early - pressed for effort with 2f left and edged back into third inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish third
Held up in rear - moved into third with 2f left - pushed along a furlong out then drifted right - dropped a place and held late to finish fourth
Settled in third early - pushed along and gave up the spot approaching 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Set the pace from the off - urged forward approaching final 2f - continued to be driven with 2f remaining - found extra to the line - finished clear and untroubled
Sat behind the front group - driven up into second inside final 2f - stayed on but couldn't reel in winner
settled in the pack early - made ground into contention over 2f out - into third with a furlong left under pressure - kept on same gear to finish third
Held a midfield position early - urged into greater effort with over 2f left then driven out from the final furlong - stayed on without getting closer than fourth
Missed the break and settled at the back - not far off the pace - urged forward with 3f left - made late progress from a furlong out - kept on without threatening to finish 5th
Held a handy position early - urged forward before 2f out - unable to close the gap and dropped away in the final furlong - finished sixth
Held up in the back half - nudged forward approaching 2f out - kept on without threatening
Held up in the pack - asked for effort with 3f left - failed to quicken - eventually well held in 8th
Up with the pace - pushed along over 2f out - dropped away from that point to finish ninth
Held up at the back - urged forward with 3f left - dropped away and finished well beaten
Settled towards the back of the pack - driven forward approaching the final furlong - hit the front inside the last 110 yards under pressure - stayed on strongly to prevail

Settled at the back - moving smoothly and making ground on the front group 3f out - hampered for a gap over 1f out and boxed in more than once inside the final furlong - ran on strongly once into the open to grab second - just failed to get to the winner
Settled second early - hit front over a furlong out then squeezed for effort when overtaken close home - dropped back to finish third
Settled in third early - driven approaching final two furlongs and closed on the front pair - lost momentum close to home to finish fourth
Went straight to the front and dictated a modest gallop - urged forward 3f from home - lost command inside the final furlong and driven to respond - soon dropped away to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - urged into effort with 2f left before fading to last approaching the final furlong - trailed home well beaten
Sat just behind the top two early - shifted out from the rail with 3f left - moved through to command with a furlong to go - driven out at the finish - won with plenty in hand
Sat with the front group early - asked for effort with 2f left - moved into second inside final furlong and kept going - unable to close on a strong winner
Settled midfield - driven on approaching final furlongs to close in on leaders - kept trying but never got on terms
Handy near the outside - hit front approaching 2f out - driven then overtaken 1f out - lost place through the closing stages to finish 4th
Set the early pace - driven and lost the front spot approaching the final 2f - dropped away over a furlong out
Slow to break - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to land a blow - finished sixth
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - unable to build any momentum - well held in 7th
Held up at the back - driven to close ground over 3f out - detached from the field by 2f out
Settled midpack early - urged forward with over two furlongs left - dropped away quickly from there - eventually finished ninth
Held a spot in the pack early - moved through gears before the final furlong to hit the front - driven out to assert and stay on strongly

Fought for control early - sat close behind pace-setters - pushed along with 1f left - checked entering final furlong - moved left and rallied through final 110yds - grabbed second spot near line - denied by narrow margin
Set the pace early - driven with a furlong left - bumped slightly nearing the last furlong - overtaken close home and edged out for second
Held a forward position - pressed for effort 2f out then drifted right causing interference approaching the final furlong - lost ground late to finish fourth
Sluggish start - settled just behind the pace - asked for effort with 2f remaining then squeezed for space inside the final furlong - unable to land a blow finishing fifth
Settled just off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close - finished sixth well beaten
Settled in second early - hit front inside final two furlongs and asked for effort then edged wide with 110 yards left - kept finding late to prevail
Settled at the back - made ground 2f out - switched into fourth and driven over 1f out - ran on with purpose inside the final 110yds and challenged for the lead - went down by a short head
Sat just behind the leading two - asked for effort 2f out - stayed on without threatening
Went straight to the front - pushed along with 2f left before losing the advantage - dropped away in the final furlong to finish fourth
Held up towards back - urged into effort with 2f left - lost touch through closing stages - finished 5th
Settled towards the back early - made ground on the pack approaching 2f out - edged through middle of track inside the final furlong - hit front close to line and drew clear
Pressed the pace from near the outset - moved to the front 2f out - challenged and lost the lead inside the final 110yds - found no more late on to finish second
Settled in the pack early - moved up to challenge the front group with 3f left - urged forward approaching the final furlong to claim third - stayed on without matching the winner's turn of foot late
Settled in the pack - stuck for room and unable to press forward a furlong out - lost ground to the front three and faded to finish fourth
Set the pace early - driven when overtaken 2f out - dropped away rapidly in the closing stages - finished 5th beaten 7 lengths
Settled at the back of the field - unable to quicken from 2f out - fell away thereafter - finished 6th
Made all - pressed and put in front close home - drifted left but kept finding more - got up in the closing strides to prevail
Settled in midfield - improved into contention over 2f out under pressure - nosed in front approaching the final furlong and stayed on well - caught in the last strides going down by a whisker
Held tracking spot behind front group - urged into effort 2f out and drifted left - kept on final furlong but lacked the speed to get closer
Slow to begin - settled towards the back - pushed along over a furlong out and finished with running - moved into fourth late but never reached the front runners
Handy early - urged forward with 2f left - lost momentum inside final furlong to finish 5th
Drifted right at the off - settled towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on without threatening the front end - finished 6th beaten 2½ lengths
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - faded steadily thereafter to finish seventh
Held up at rear early - pushed into third spot with over 2f left - moved up to second inside final furlong - hit front late and edged clear to score
Sat behind pace early - roused to hit front over a furlong out before being overtaken in the last furlong - rallied but narrowly denied at the line
Settled into a strong grip early - went to the front - driven and overtaken approaching the final furlong - dropped to third and unable to find more late
Held up in rear - pushed along and slipped to the back 2f out - unable to quicken - finished fourth
